conventions.reverse: true when head and tail of the FB (or WK-75) triple must be swapped to align with the target property's direction
conventions.keep: the merged relation takes the keep member's label and the keep member's native direction
conventions.relabel: for an active group, every triple (h, m, t) of a present member m becomes (h, keep, t), or (t, keep, h) when swap_head_tail_when_relabelling_to_keep is true; duplicates in the inference graph are dropped
conventions.present: the relation has at least one triple in the inference graph (FB: train_ind, the graph ULTRA builds the test-time relation graph from; WK-75: msg.txt = inference_graph)
conventions.active_group: one rule for both sections: a group is applied to an inference graph only when at least two of its members are present in that graph (FB: per version, listed in active_in; WK-75: the single graph, recorded as active)

rules.A: the Wikidata image is a main-value statement: A1 direct row, A2 empty row annotated 'reverse of' a mapped property, A3 CVT link and CVT main property share one property (converter CVT rule, incl. its ITEM and SPOUSE special cases), A4 path that reverses a CVT main property
rules.B: CVT path whose object becomes a qualifier of the subject's statement (link property -> property, CVT property -> qualifier)

conventions.yago_mapping: a WK-75 group is a set of Wikidata properties that the YAGO 4.5 shapes map to one YAGO property and to no other; YAGO keeps the Wikidata direction, so no member is reversed
conventions.yago_class_scope: YAGO attaches each mapping to node shapes (classes, listed per member as yago_shapes); WK-75 has no entity types, so the relabelling applies each mapping to every triple of the property, whatever the subject's class
conventions.profile: 8 integers per relation node of ULTRA's relation graph built from the inference graph with inverse relations: out-degree for h2h, t2t, h2t, t2h, then in-degree in the same order; self-loops count
conventions.displacement_L1: L1 distance between a member's node profile in the original inference graph and the merged relation's node profile in the merged inference graph, both in the target direction (the same value in the inverse direction)
conventions.strata: merged = query relation is a member of an applied group; profile_shifted = other relation whose node profile (either direction) changed; profile_identical = the rest
conventions.absorbed: evaluation triples that, after relabelling, coincide with a triple of the merged inference graph; exclude them from both arms
conventions.evaluated_split: pilot_harness.load_inductive uses ULTRA's FB15k237Inductive with merge_valid_test=True, so FB queries are valid_ind + test_ind; WK-75 queries are test.txt
conventions.filter: FB: merged inference graph + merged valid_ind + merged test_ind; WK-75: merged inference graph + merged valid + merged test (the harness filters, relabelled)
conventions.loader_note: ULTRA's GraIL loader builds the relation vocabulary from the transductive train.txt/valid.txt and asserts every inductive relation is in it; relabel all five raw files, and use a fresh dataset root because processed tensors are cached
